name: @magpie-community/page-harnessweight
description: HarnessWeight: a magpie page that weighs every agent harness behind your gateway, by agent rather than by model: input tokens, cache hit rate, tokens at full price, failures, latency, and the tool definitions each harness re-sends every turn

summary.en: Weigh every agent harness behind your gateway — Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, DeepSeek Harness… — by agent, not by model: input tokens, cache hit rate, tokens at full price, failures, latency, and how heavy the tool definitions each harness re-sends every turn are. Plain-language takeaways, magpie's own agent names and icons. Its local service reads this machine's usage.jsonl; a read-only hook samples tool sizes (names and numbers only).
summary.zh: 给网关后面的每个 agent harness 称重（Claude Code、Codex、ZCode、DeepSeek Harness……），按 Agent 而不是按模型：输入 token、缓存命中、按原价的 token、失败率、延迟，以及每轮重发的工具定义有多重。顶部直接给结论，名字和图标与 magpie 一致。本机服务读 usage.jsonl；只读 hook 采样工具定义大小（只记名字和数字）。

author: webkubor
